data.one_liner: Fast and productive web framework for Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides a web framework for building applications in Dart. It supports routing, HTTP networking, and component-based UI architecture.
use_when: Developing production applications that require an Angular-style framework structure
avoid_when: Building non-web native mobile or desktop apps
Using modern Flutter widgets instead of web-specific components
strengths: Focused on productivity, performance, and stability
Extensively used in production for large-scale applications
weaknesses: Maintained by the community rather than Google officially
data.setup_notes: Requires configuration for web builds and Dart setup.
